Messages.Author: Murr
Messages.Body:
I know this may be a simple question. By definition a reaction card
requires a "ready" vampire. Unless spefically stated, does the ready
vampire need to be untapped? One such card that I can think of is
Telepathic counter.

Telepathic Counter Reaction Auspex
Normal: Reduce a bleed against you by 1. Note that bleeds ending up at
0 or less are not considered successful.
Superior: As above, but reduce bleed by 2 Artist: Susan Van Camp

Messages.Author: Quicksilver
Messages.Body:
Murr wrote:



The rules are extremely clear. See page 11 where it describes reaction
cards. It says:
"Your untapped minions may use these cards ..."

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Murr wrote:
>
> I know this may be a simple question. By definition a reaction card
> requires a "ready" vampire. Unless spefically stated, does the ready
> vampire need to be untapped?

Yes. By definition, a reaction card requires a "ready untapped minion"
(not necessarily a vampire).

Revised Rulebook: [1.6.3.5]

The VTES rulebook failed to state that the minion had to be ready,
but it does explicitly state "untapped". [2], [3.2.2]
